item.title: Emugate
item.description: Browser-based multiplayer retro gaming platform. Stream classic games in real-time over H.264/WebSocket — no plugins, no installs, up to 4 players.

item.title: Gate Bevy
item.description: Multiplayer 3D action game engine and world editor built on Bevy. Third-person gameplay, dedicated server, Lua-scripted UI, and a browser-based map editor.
